title: Jabra Headset Cannot Pair
shortDescription: Elite or Evolve headset cannot pair with phone, dongle, or laptop.
fullDescription:
Jabra business headsets (Evolve series) often pair to a USB Bluetooth dongle (Link 370/380). If the dongle was paired previously to a different headset, new pairing fails. Resetting both is required.

Elite consumer earbuds use the Sound+ app for guided pairing.

causes.cause: Dongle still bound to old headset

symptoms: Dongle LED solid blue (paired) but no audio

fixSteps.title: Reset Evolve
fixSteps.instruction: Hold answer / multifunction button 8 seconds until LED flashes purple.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair dongle
fixSteps.instruction: Open Jabra Direct on PC -> Devices -> Pair new device.

fixSteps.title: Sound+ for Elite
fixSteps.instruction: Use Sound+ app -> Add new device.

faq.a: Both Link 370 (USB-A) and Link 380 (USB-A or USB-C) supported.

title: Headset Mic Not Picking Up
shortDescription: Microphone not transmitting voice on Teams / Zoom.
fullDescription:
Jabra headsets present as both audio output and input. If Windows / macOS picks the laptop mic instead, no audio reaches Teams or Zoom.

Also, the boom arm position on Evolve series enables mute when raised.
symptoms: Mic level flat in Teams test

fixSteps.title: Lower boom
fixSteps.instruction: Pull boom arm down, mute LED should turn off.

fixSteps.title: Set device
fixSteps.instruction: Sound settings -> Input -> Jabra Evolve / Link Hands-Free.

fixSteps.title: Check privacy
fixSteps.instruction: Windows Privacy -> Microphone -> allow Teams / Zoom.

whenToCallPro: If multiple headsets fail same way — likely IT policy issue.
videoSearchQuery: Jabra mic not working Teams fix

faq.a: Yes, busy light syncs with Teams mute on supported models.

title: Busylight Always Off or Always On
shortDescription: Red busy LED no longer reflects call status.
fullDescription:
Jabra busylight integrates with Teams or Webex through Jabra Direct. If Direct is not running or the Teams variant of the headset is paired with a non-Teams dongle, the indicator misbehaves.

Firmware mismatch between dongle and headset can also break the link.
symptoms: Busylight does not turn red on call

fixSteps.title: Restart Jabra Direct
fixSteps.instruction: Quit Jabra Direct, reopen. Confirm Teams integration is on.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Jabra Direct -> Update both dongle and headset.

faq.a: MS has dedicated Teams button; UC works generically.

title: Jabra Elite Earbud Will Not Charge in Case
shortDescription: One earbud shows no charge LED in case.
fullDescription:
Elite earbuds rely on small magnetic contacts in the case. Earwax, sweat, and lint can coat both bud contacts and case pads, breaking the charging path.

A cleaning with a dry cotton swab usually restores charging.

causes.cause: Dirty contacts on bud or case

symptoms: No LED on bud in case

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe bud and case pads with dry cotton swab.

fixSteps.title: Charge case
fixSteps.instruction: Plug case into USB-C charger 30 min, then put buds in.

whenToCallPro: If still dead under warranty — Jabra ships replacement earbud.
videoSearchQuery: Jabra Elite not charging case fix

faq.a: Yes IP57 means rinsing under water is safe to clean.

title: Jabra Active Noise Cancelling Reduced
shortDescription: ANC effectiveness drops on Elite earbuds or Evolve2 headset.
fullDescription:
Jabra ANC depends on a sealed in-ear fit (Elite) or memory-foam earcushions (Evolve2). Worn cushions, wrong tip size, or background SmartSound switching to Quiet/Commute reduces effectiveness.

A reset and Sound+ Personalize ANC walk-through tunes per ear canal.

fixSteps.title: Replace tips
fixSteps.instruction: Try larger or smaller silicone tip for proper seal.

whenToCallPro: If both buds clean and seal is good but ANC absent — hardware fault.
videoSearchQuery: Jabra Elite ANC not working fix

title: Jabra Firmware Update Stuck
shortDescription: Sound+ or Jabra Direct firmware update fails to complete.
fullDescription:
Firmware updates over Bluetooth are sensitive to range and battery level. If the headset is below 20% or moves too far from the phone, update aborts.

For Evolve / Engage, use Jabra Direct on a PC with the dongle for the most reliable update path.

causes.cause: Headset out of range during update

fixSteps.title: Use Jabra Direct PC
fixSteps.instruction: Connect via dongle, run Jabra Direct desktop -> Update.

whenToCallPro: If headset bricks (not recoverable via Jabra Direct).

title: Cannot Connect to Two Devices
shortDescription: Headset connects to only one device at a time despite multipoint.
fullDescription:
Multipoint requires two devices to be paired separately. Some Jabra firmware versions ship with multipoint disabled by default and require enabling in Sound+ or Jabra Direct.

Mixing a dongle and a phone counts as multipoint and works on Evolve2.
symptoms: Drops first device when second connects

fixSteps.title: Pair second device
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect first, put headset in pair mode, pair second device, then reconnect first.

faq.a: Two simultaneous active; up to 8 paired.

title: Voice Sounds Robotic on Calls
shortDescription: Outgoing voice on Teams sounds robotic or chopped.
fullDescription:
Robotic / chopped audio is a sign that the Bluetooth link is using HFP / SCO codec at low quality, or that the dongle has weak signal. USB-A on the front of a desktop tower often loses range; an extension to the desktop helps.

Windows audio enhancements can also corrupt mic audio.

causes.cause: Weak dongle signal (USB on rear of tower)

fixSteps.title: USB extension
fixSteps.instruction: Use a 2-3 ft USB extension cable so dongle sits on desk.

faq.a: Yes Evolve2 30 SE wired model avoids the issue entirely.

title: Background Noise Suppression Not Working
shortDescription: Callers still hear background noise despite Jabra noise reduction.
fullDescription:
Jabra mic noise cancellation is a multi-mic algorithm that needs the boom or stems oriented correctly. If the boom mic is positioned too far from the corner of the mouth, the algorithm cannot separate voice from noise.

Firmware often improves NC; keep it updated.

fixSteps.title: Position boom
fixSteps.instruction: Boom about 2 cm from corner of mouth, microphone facing chin.

videoSearchQuery: Jabra Evolve2 noise cancelling mic fix

faq.a: On Evolve2 75, stereo gives better NC than mono mode.

title: Jabra Engage Base Station Not Powering On
shortDescription: Engage 65/75 base station LED ring is dark.
fullDescription:
The Engage base station provides charging and DECT connection. If the AC adapter or the USB-C power cable is faulty, the base will not power up.

In rare cases the firmware on the base hangs and a hard reset is required.

fixSteps.title: Try different outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug into a known good wall outlet.

fixSteps.title: Hard reset
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug power and headset for 60 sec, replug.

whenToCallPro: If base remains dead with new adapter — internal failure.
videoSearchQuery: Jabra Engage base no power fix

faq.a: Engage 75 reaches up to 150 m line of sight.
